notes.title: Character Creator Release Date!
notes.content:
🌷Exciting News for Pixelart Character Creator!🌷


I'm thrilled to announce that my Pixelart Character Creator is entering its final phase!
I'm beyond excited to share the official release date with you all!🥰


✨Release date: 19/09/2025



Get ready to craft unique characters for your adventures! Below is a sneak peek at the features available on launch. I’m already working on more updates, so stay tuned for even more customization options in the future!



🛠️Features at Launch:

2 Character Types: Choose your character's vibe!

10 Vibrant Colors: Customize skin tones for each character type.

20 Eye Styles: From sparkling to soulful, pick the perfect gaze.

20 Beards & Mustaches: Add some rustic charm or keep it clean-shaven.

20 Mouth Expressions: Show off your character's personality, from grins to smirks.

40 Hairstyles: 20 unique styles per character type for that perfect look.

40 Clothing Options: 20 outfits per character type, from overalls to cozy sweaters.

Pants, Accessories & More: Complete your character's style with extra flair!



Thank you for your support, and I can’t wait to see the amazing characters you create!💖
